material: 8620 steel; carburize, harden and grind; Rockwell C 60–62
finish: Ground; no numerical surface roughness specified.
general_tolerance: UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED: THIRD ANGLE PROJECTION; DIMENSIONS IN INCHES; 2-PLACE DIM. ±.020; 3-PLACE DIM. ±.010; ANGULAR DIM. ±1°.

views.description: Left-hand longitudinal side elevation of the collet pad: axial length, stepped outside diameters, central raised circumferential flange, shoulder reliefs, radial tapped hole mouths, bore hidden lines and end chamfers.
views.centerline_notes: Short centerlines identify radial tapped hole axes. Hidden longitudinal lines show the central axial bore and its left-end entrance chamfer. The horizontal gap is a sawcut, not a drawing break.

views.description: Right-hand circular end view, consistent with the stated third-angle projection. Shows central bore, four radial sawcuts, concentric outside steps and four hidden radial tapped holes at diagonal positions.
views.centerline_notes: Horizontal and vertical centerlines locate the common axis and bisect the four centered sawcuts. Diagonal centerlines locate radial tapped holes; one hole axis is 45° from the vertical slot axis. Four equally spaced holes and four equally spaced slots each imply 90° indexing.

features.description: Base cylinder, outside diameter 3.7495 and axial length 1.687. Use a circular end-plane sketch with origin on the cylinder axis; axial zero is the left end of the longitudinal view.
Coaxial raised flange, diameter 3.875, axial width .372; starts .625 from the left end. Sketch on an end-parallel plane at axial coordinate .625.

Two circumferential shoulder reliefs, one immediately adjacent to each flange face. Drawing note is 'MIN. RADIUS U CUT'. Implement as annular cuts only after the missing groove widths, root diameters and minimum-radius requirements are resolved.

Seed radial blind tapped hole, .375-24, tapped .38 deep. Axis lies in the plane 1.375 from the left end and is 45° from the vertical end-view centerline. Thread class, tap drill and drill-point depth are unspecified.
Circular pattern of radial tapped seed hole: four total instances, 90° apart about the cylinder axis, one on each diagonal.
Countersink the four radial tapped hole mouths .03 deep. Angle and major diameter are not provided; exact countersink shape must be resolved before building.
Seed centered .060-wide radial sawcut connecting the axial bore to the outside, through the full axial thickness as shown. First slot lies on a cardinal radial centerline.
Four total radial sawcuts at 90° intervals. These split the pad into four separate quadrant segments; preserve a multibody result.
Right-end main outside diameter edge chamfer, .06 × 45°.

symmetry.plane: Longitudinal plane through the horizontal diameter in the Right view
symmetry.description: Geometry is mirror symmetric about this axial plane, excluding stamped identification.

symmetry.plane: Longitudinal plane through the vertical diameter in the Right view
symmetry.description: Four quadrants, with holes halfway between sawcuts. No axial midlength symmetry: flange and chamfers are not axially symmetric.

concentric_groups.description: Main outside cylinder, flange, annular reliefs, axial bore and circular end chamfers share the longitudinal axis.
Each radial tapped hole entrance countersink is coaxial with its own radial hole; the four radial holes are not mutually coaxial.

equal_spacing.computed_from: 4 HOLES EQ. SPACED: 360° / 4 = 90°. Spacing value is angular degrees, not inches; hole axes offset 45° from sawcut axes.
4 SLOTS EQ. SPACED: 360° / 4 = 90°. Spacing value is angular degrees, not inches.

dimension_chains.description: Overall axial length = left-end-to-flange distance + flange width + right remainder: 1.687 = .625 + .372 + .690.
Hole location from left flange face: .750 = .372 + .378.

warnings: No ASME/ISO/DIN standard designation is printed. Third-angle projection and inch units are explicit; the standard field is intentionally blank.
No revision is legibly specified in the title block.

Two shoulder reliefs are called out only as 'MIN. RADIUS U CUT'. No numeric radius, groove width or root diameter is provided. Exact geometry requires clarification; do not obtain dimensions by scaling the image.
The four tapped-hole entrance countersinks have .03 depth specified but no included angle or major diameter. These must be resolved for exact geometry.

Tapped holes are radial, not axial holes on a planar bolt circle. They are located by axial station and angular indexing. No edge-referenced planar hole-center coordinates are printed, so instance_positions is intentionally empty.
The .38 depth applies to tapping; tap-drill diameter, blind drilled depth and point angle are not specified. The reported .375 hole diameter is the nominal thread diameter, not the minor diameter.
Angular dimensions and angular pattern spacings are in degrees; the dimension schema only permits length-unit labels, so angular dimension unit fields carry inch with explanatory notes.
The four full-length sawcuts produce four disconnected quadrant pads. Do not force the finished part into a single connected solid.
Stamp instruction: 'SB-12059' and '.625 DIA.' on the indicated end face. Letter size, marking depth and exact position are unspecified; marking is not modeled as an invented cut.
Assembly note: 'COMPLETE WITH #193 LUGS'. Lug geometry and attachment details are not provided on this drawing and cannot be extracted as buildable solids.
Title block additionally identifies model 220-B, date March 16, 1979, and use with COLLET SB-1944 and CHUCK SB-12054.
No GD&T feature control frames or datum letters are shown. General dimensional and angular tolerances apply where indicated; derived nominal dimensions have no independent tolerances.
